judgement.reason: The scanner found Prisma configured only for SQLite, and the product keeps its documents and built-in vector database on local disk, which stateless Deployz containers lose on every restart; the shown lines do not prove there is no PostgreSQL option.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: Prisma configured with the SQLite provider. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only.
